note.question: How can near-optimal dispatch policies support emergency medical services?
note.overview: Emergency medical services (EMS) are vital for ensuring timely and effective healthcare delivery. Ambulance dispatching in EMS directly influences patient outcomes. These systems face the challenge of managing limited resources to respond promptly to emergency calls while maintaining the capacity to address potential future incidents.
